title: PR #100 review fixes: PC-only /switch, stale active-id handling, design doc migration text
description: Code review on PR #100 (multi-PC) raised three scoped fixes: (1) /switch must reject non-PC party members (role!='pc'); (2) handle stale/invalid active_character_id (and explicit actingCharacterId) with a controlled domain error instead of a TypeError when the row is missing; (3) update docs/multi-pc-design.md migration text now that v9->v10 adds turn_trace.acting_character_id.
close_reason: PR #100 review fixes pushed (db6d58c): (1) setActiveCharacterId validates role='pc' + existence -> CharacterResolutionError; /switch rejects non-PCs via existing CLI catch, active unchanged; tool targeting unaffected. (2) readStateSnapshot throws CharacterResolutionError on stale/missing active or explicit acting id instead of TypeError. (3) design doc migration text updated for additive v9->v10. biome+typecheck clean; full suite 772 passed/3 skipped (only the known dolt timeout flakes fail under parallel load; checkpoint 65/65 in isolation). 8 new/updated tests.
